name: menubar
title: Menubar
purpose: Present persistent top-level menus with coherent horizontal and menu keyboard navigation.
accessibility: The root and triggers use menubar and menuitem semantics.
Left, Right, Home, and End move top-level roving focus.
An open menu transfers across adjacent triggers and restores focus on Escape.
commonMistakes: Using Menubar as a site Navbar.

examples.title: Editor menus
examples.description: Top-level triggers use horizontal roving focus.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Menubar from "@/components/ui/Menubar.vue";
import { ref } from "vue";
import type { MenubarMenu } from "@/components/ui/Menubar.vue";

const openMenu = ref<string | null>(null);
const menus: readonly MenubarMenu[] = [
  { id: "file", label: "File placeholder", items: [{ id: "file-action", label: "New placeholder" }] },
  { id: "edit", label: "Edit placeholder", items: [{ id: "edit-action", label: "Undo placeholder" }] },
];

function handleSelect(item: unknown): void {
  console.info("Selected", item);
}
</script>

<template>
  <Menubar id="editor-menubar" v-model="openMenu" label="Editor menu placeholder" :menus="menus" @select="handleSelect" />
</template>
